props.title: Join evidence, not names
props.subtitle: Keep refresh scheduling mechanical, runtime values unresolved, and cross-repository joins explicit.

props.content: The aggregate graph POC does not need a new database or an agent that guesses the organization. It needs one external timer, one overlap boundary, and a query-time semantic view that composes Codebase Memory facts with admitted `.ulta/entities` relationships while preserving unresolved runtime configuration.

props.title: Build the overlay at query time
props.content: Use Codebase Memory as the structural source, `.ulta/entities` as the organization-aware semantic source, and a deterministic join routine as the arbiter. The agent may expand searches and explain gaps; it must not fabricate cross-repository edges from matching business names.
props.next: Prove the model with the two real cart-add branches: customer AddToBag routes to ATG, while HandleCart's add branch routes through ultaBuyAPI to orch-buy.

props.label: 01 · Scheduling boundary
props.title: The timer schedules; the run only runs
props.subtitle: A failed refresh cannot prevent the next tick because cadence lives outside the refresh process.

props.content:
flowchart TD
  Timer["External timer
cron, platform scheduler, or Compose profile"] -->|"every tick"| Lock{"flock acquired?"}
  Lock -->|"yes"| Refresh["One-shot sync and delta index"]
  Lock -->|"busy"| Skip["Skip this tick"]
  Refresh --> State["Persist successful repository hashes"]
  Refresh -->|"success or crash"| Release["Process exits; kernel releases lock"]
  Release --> Next["Next timer tick remains scheduled"]
  Skip --> Next
  Next --> Timer
props.caption: The lock prevents overlap within one Linux container. It is not a distributed lock across replicas.

props.label: Operating rule
props.title: One replica, one short-lived lock
props.content:
Production invokes `flock -n /tmp/context-engine-refresh.lock npm run codebase-memory:sync` on every timer tick. If the prior run still owns the lock, the tick skips. If the run crashes, the operating system closes its lock descriptor.

Native development stays manual with `npm run codebase-memory:refresh` or `npm run codebase-memory:sync`. Docker development can opt into the same scheduled profile because `flock` runs inside Linux, regardless of the host OS.

props.label: 02 · Runtime configuration
props.title: The graph knows the key, not the deployed value
props.subtitle: DXL constructs the request from one environment variable, one request-context version, and a source-controlled route suffix.

props.content:
${ULTA_SERVICE_DOMAIN}
  + /ecom/
  + ${ctx.buyServiceVersion}
  + /orch/buy/cart/additem

CBM node: EnvVar(ULTA_SERVICE_DOMAIN)
CBM edge: code -[:CONFIGURES {strategy: env_access}]-> EnvVar
Stored env value: absent
Resolved request version: absent

props.title: Do not promote `.env` text to runtime truth
props.content: The current repository tracks `.env` and `.env.local.qa`, but the live CBM `EnvVar` node stores only identity—not a literal value. Even a checked-in value can be overridden at deployment. The semantic view should retain `envKey`, `pathTemplate`, and unresolved placeholders. Add a sanitized deployment inventory later only when environment-specific topology is required.

props.label: 03 · Cart capability
props.title: One business phrase, two real dispatch paths
props.subtitle: A name-only join would incorrectly connect the customer AddToBag mutation to orch-buy.

rows.meaning: Customer AddToBag is not an orch-buy edge in the current checkout.
The DXL-to-orch route is supported by entities and source, with host, version, and gateway transformation unresolved.

props.title: Why this is the right POC slice
props.claim: A trustworthy semantic layer must preserve both cart-add paths instead of merging them by name.
props.evidence: The admitted web entity maps AddToBag to the DXL AddToBag operation; its resolver invokes ATG. Separately, HandleCart conditionally invokes ultaBuyAPI.addItemToBagOrchAgent, which builds the orch-buy route template.
props.limitation: The checked-in web entity catalog does not currently identify a web entry for HandleCart, so that chain begins at the DXL operation until a source-backed caller is admitted.

props.label: 04 · Semantic overlay
props.title: Retrieve, enrich, join, then audit
props.subtitle: The overlay is an ephemeral typed view over two evidence systems; it does not mutate Codebase Memory's database.

props.content:
flowchart TD
  Query["Business query
add to cart"] --> Alias["Capability alias
commerce.cart.add_item"]
  Alias --> CBM["CBM retrieval per repository
symbols, calls, EnvVar usage, route fragments"]
  CBM --> Entities["Entity refinement
operations, datasource methods, backend joins, routes"]
  Entities --> Join["Deterministic semantic join
method + verb + path suffix + backend identity"]
  Join --> Legacy["Chain A · admitted
AddToBag → atgAPI"]
  Legacy --> ATG["ATG cart"]
  Join --> Agent["Chain B · admitted + derived
HandleCart add → ultaBuyAPI"]
  Agent --> Template["Request template
env host + version + orch route"]
  Template --> Orch["orch-buy
POST /orch/buy/cart/additem"]
  Join --> Audit["Audit output
native · admitted · derived · candidate · unresolved"]
props.caption: The agent controls query expansion and explanation. Deterministic rules own join construction and provenance labels.

props.title: Join contract
props.content:
## Native facts stay authoritative

Codebase Memory supplies structural nodes and edges. A native `CROSS_*` edge outranks every overlay inference. Reindexing may replace a derived join with a native one, but an overlay never overwrites source facts.

## Entities add organization meaning

Checked-in `.ulta/entities` relations contribute admitted operation, datasource, backend, route, and integration identities. They are used after graph retrieval, not as an excuse to skip code discovery.

## The joiner is deterministic

The smallest useful routine normalizes capability aliases, follows typed entity IDs, compares HTTP verb and route suffix, retains gateway prefixes and runtime placeholders, and emits evidence references. The agent may ask for another graph query when a join remains ambiguous.

## Gaps remain visible

Missing native `CROSS_HTTP_CALLS`, an unresolved environment value, an unknown `buyServiceVersion`, or competing branch candidates appear in `gaps`. They do not silently become high-confidence edges.

props.title: Claim ledger
props.summary: Live graph queries and current checked-in source inspected on 18 August 2026.

items.claim: CBM represents ULTA_SERVICE_DOMAIN as an EnvVar and connects readers with CONFIGURES edges.
items.detail: The live query returned getURLDomain and willSendRequest among thirteen code-to-env relationships.

items.claim: The live EnvVar node does not contain the environment value.
items.detail: Returned properties were identity fields only; no literal or resolved value was present.
Values were deliberately redacted during inspection.

items.claim: The customer AddToBag resolver dispatches to atgAPI.addItemToBag.
items.detail: The source passes `atgAPI` and `addItemToBag` into invokeMutation.

items.claim: HandleCart's add branch dispatches to ultaBuyAPI.addItemToBagOrchAgent.
items.detail: The conditional handler selects add, update, or remove datasource methods and defaults to the add method.

items.claim: The DXL orchestration datasource and orch-buy route form a supported cross-repository candidate.
items.detail: The source route template and admitted POST route agree on `/orch/buy/cart/additem`; runtime host, version, and gateway behavior remain separate.

items.claim: A native CROSS_HTTP_CALLS edge currently connects the DXL method to the orch-buy controller.
items.detail: The fresh v0.10.6 cross-repository rebuild produced zero edges for the exp-graphql and orch-buy pair. Java route extraction currently emits root paths for these interface-defined annotations.

props.label: 05 · POC sequence
props.title: Prove one honest capability view
props.subtitle: No persistent aggregate database is required for the first proof.

props.title: Compose one query result
props.content: Add a CLI query path for `commerce.cart.add_item` that runs CBM discovery, loads relevant entity records, and returns typed chains plus gaps. Keep the result ephemeral.

props.title: Reject the false join
props.content: The acceptance check requires both real branches and fails if customer AddToBag is connected to orch-buy merely because names and route intent resemble one another.

props.title: Wrap the proven routine with MCP
props.content: Once the CLI result is stable, expose the same query routine through MCP for business estimation and architecture exercises. The transport changes; the evidence and join contract do not.
